title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta10

## Managed Schedule dispatch and weather recovery

This beta tightens Navimower Schedule command ownership and fixes a field case where a schedule window selected the correct zone but a later manual `navimower.mow` command could be mistaken for the scheduler's own successful start.

- Managed starts now carry retry/cycle-baseline metadata so an unaccepted start may be retried safely without blindly resetting a task that the mower already accepted.
- A fresh manual mowing command for the same expected zone is adopted as `external_same_zone_adopted` so the queue can continue, but it is no longer relabelled as `scheduler_start_confirmed`.
- A manual mowing command for a different zone suspends the managed queue as `external_override` instead of silently stealing ownership.
- Vendor weather delays are retained as scheduler-owned interruptions. MQTT `taskDelay` is authoritative when available and recent vendor `150A`/`150F` notifications label rain/snow delays.
- Weather wait keeps the current queue slot reserved, waits for the mower's own automatic resume first, and only falls back to the existing non-resetting Resume/continue path after a 120-second clear-weather grace period.
- A managed start that never changes the vendor cycle may retry up to three times at 60-second intervals. If the vendor cycle already changed but cutting never becomes active, the scheduler fails closed instead of issuing another reset.

## Field case

The beta9 diagnostic showed a managed Street2 slot marked as scheduler-owned while the latest mowing task had actually been started by `navimower.mow`, followed by vendor weather-delay code `150A` and MQTT `task_delay=true`. Beta10 separates those states so diagnostics and retry/resume behavior match the real command source.

No Map Card update is required.
